# feature-requests #1038: Compile time of a switch statement grows with about the third power of the number of values in a case range

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/feature-requests/1038/
- Category: [Fixes that need a decision](../../fix-decision.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17228
- Recommended action: Decide on the choices in Decision about jump tables, warnings, and ranges that are empty after conversion. Then apply and close.
- Patch: [feature-requests-1038.patch](../../patches/feature-requests-1038.patch), commit [`3ea2c7749`](https://github.com/mdmower/sdcc/commit/3ea2c7749bfdd6f9a64910f02ffb08dacc87d6c7). Applies to r17228 without the other patches.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

With the ticket's command `sdcc -mmcs51 --std-c2y -DN=... -c main.c`, r17228 with this report's
other patches takes 0.03 s for N=256, 0.58 s for N=257, 17.55 s for N=1024, and 131.58 s for N=2048.
With `--model-large` it was stopped after 900 s for N=7936. With the patch, each takes 0.01 s.

## Cause

`createCaseRange()` in `src/SDCCast.c` calls `createCase()` for each value of the range. When the
cases span more values than `port->jumptableCost.maxCount`, 256 for mcs51, `geniCodeJumpTable()` in
`src/SDCCicode.c` returns 0 before its size comparison, the heuristic that the ticket's comment asks
about. `geniCodeSwitch()` then emits a comparison and a conditional jump for each value. For N=1024,
callgrind counts 53% of the instructions in `computeDataFlow()` and 29.5% in the peephole pass.

## Fix

`createCaseRange()` makes one case with one label, for the first value of the range. The last value
follows it in `swVals` with the new flag `caseRangeEnd`. For each range, `geniCodeSwitch()` emits
`cond < first` and `cond > last`, and `geniCodeJumpTable()` adds the label once for each value. For
`--nosidechannels`, each value of a range counts as a case, as in trunk. The patch removes two more
faults. Without it, ranges that end at 0x7fffffff do not finish compiling, because
`cVal <= cValHigh` is true for every `int`. Ranges that label a statement outside a statement list,
as in `switch (n) case 2 ... 4: r = 1;`, stop sdcc with a segmentation fault, because the action of
`labeled_statement` in `src/SDCC.y` keeps only the last of their labels.

## Decision

- **Jump table.** In its size comparison, `geniCodeJumpTable()` counts each range as two cases, and
  trunk counts each value, which is the alternative. For `case 10 ... 40:` on an `unsigned char`,
  trunk emits a jump table for mcs51 and stm8, and sdcc with the patch emits two comparisons. By the
  source, the same holds for the ticket's file on stm8. That and the run time are untested.
- **Warnings.** For a bound that the type of the condition cannot have, sdcc for mcs51 with the
  patch prints warnings 94 and 110 once for the `switch` line. Trunk prints them where it emits
  comparisons, and neither where it selects a jump table, as for `case 200 ... 256` on an
  `unsigned char`. Ranges above the type also get warning 126 for that line with the patch.
- **Conversion.** `case -3 ... 300` on an `unsigned int` is empty after conversion. In ucsim for
  mcs51 with `--model-large`, over all 65536 values, it matches 0 to 300 and 65533 to 65535 with
  trunk, without a warning, and no value with the patch, with warnings 110 and 126. `case -3 ... 3`
  matches no value with either. Trunk's `c2y-case-range-constraints.c` cites N3886 6.8.5.3p4 for
  the rule that the conversion to the type of the condition must not change a value of a range.

## Verification

`support/regression/tests/feature-request-1038.c` has 94 assertions and ranges of up to 768 values,
and it also passes without the rest of the patch, with 22596 bytes for mcs51-small against 7347 with
the patch. `caseranges.c` with the new `testCaseRangeStatement` does not compile without the rest of
the patch. On r17228, the new valdiag file fails only in TEST8, which has `case 200 ... 256`, for
mcs51, mcs51-large, and stm8. A test outside the patch with a range of 7936 values passes for the
host and three mcs51 variants.

With the patches of this report, the regression suite has 0 failures for host, mcs51-small,
mcs51-medium, mcs51-large, mcs51-huge, mcs51-small-stack-auto, mcs51-large-stack-auto, stm8, and
ucz80, and the diagnostics suite has 0 failures for mcs51, mcs51-large, mcs51-stack-auto, z80,
and stm8. Among the other tests, the patch changes the assembly of `caseranges.c` only, for the six
mcs51 variants, stm8, and ucz80.

## Related

- local 0021 is the reason that the tests do not have a range that ends at 0x7fffffff.
- `createCaseRange()` compares the bounds as `int`. For `case 0x7ffffff0 ... 0x80000010` on an
  `unsigned long`, sdcc prints warning 300 and ignores the case, with and without the patch.
- N single cases above the limit of the jump table are N comparisons with and without the patch.
